name: the launch screen

regions_read.verdict_on_region: unconventional position (centred); names the app, not the place -- dismissed as a location signal

identifier_found: none that names the place; the only words are the app's name and "This process may contain ads"
accessibility_text: none -- no content_description on any view
initial_rationale: logo, app name and an unlabelled progress indicator; no title, no nav bar, no phrase saying the app is starting

test_cases.precondition: launch screen on screen, progress bar filling
test_cases.action: read the centred text "PDF Reader, PDF Viewer" and decide whether it names a place or the app
test_cases.expected_result: the text names the app only, or it names a part of the app
test_cases.confirms_if: it is the app’s own name and nothing else on the screen names where the user is
test_cases.overturns_if: some other visible text names the screen
test_cases.observed_result: "PDF Reader, PDF Viewer" is the app's name (the same words as the store listing); the progress bar has no label; nothing else names the screen

deciding_evidence: no text other than the app's own name appears in any moment of the live launch screen; the splash exception applies to a disappearing-identifier transition, not to whether this screen names itself, and no scroll transition touches it. Low impact: transient, and it hands over by itself
recommendation: label the progress indicator, e.g. "Starting PDF Reader..." or "Loading", so the screen says what it is
